entities.name: Claudio Antón de Luzuriaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Claudio Antón de Luzuriaga was a Spanish lawyer and politician who served as Minister of State in 1854, in a cabinet headed by Baldomero Espartero, 1st Duke of la Victoria. Loyal to the Progressive Party and to Espartero, he declined the offer of the unionist Leopoldo O'Donnell, 1st Duke of Tetuan of becoming Minister of Justice in 1856.

entities.summary: Claudio Antón de Luzuriaga was a Spanish lawyer and politician who served as Minister of State in 1854, in a cabinet headed by Baldomero Espartero, 1st Duke of la Victoria. Loyal to the Progressive Party and to Espartero, he declined the offer of the unionist Leopoldo O'Donnell, 1st Duke of Tetuan of becoming Minister of Justice in 1856.
